comment: RE-REVIEW 2026-10-22 item B, the commit half: the same order committed WITHOUT the validation preview (a line with no `seq=`), whose first variant equips the Duelist still in hand. Each step is now judged by its own effect: an equip whose host is not on the battlefield at its position is not dispatched and is REPORTED ('equip Lightning Greaves was NOT applied: its target is not on the battlefield ...'); an equip that runs is checked for the Equipment actually attached to its host. Before, Greaves never attached and nothing was said.
